feature: bop bridge: session state bridge for BopDeck
workflow_rationale: This is a new feature adding a bridge subcommand with multiple components (socket daemon, emit CLI, hook installer, opencode SSE adapter, Nushell skill). All components are in the bop-cli crate with one Nushell script in vibekanban/.

phases.name: Core types and socket emit
phases.description: Define BridgeEvent, CardStage enums with serde serialization, socket_path helper, and the fire-and-forget emit() function. This is the foundation all other components depend on.

subtasks.description: Create bridge module with BridgeEvent/CardStage types, socket_path(), events_log_path(), and emit() function. Include Display/FromStr impls for CardStage. Emit connects to Unix socket, writes JSON line, silently succeeds if socket absent.

verification.expected: 5 tests pass: test_event_serialize_session_start, test_event_serialize_stage_change, test_emit_no_socket_is_noop, test_roundtrip_all_variants, test_stage_from_str

phases.name: CLI subcommand and socket listener
phases.description: Build the bridge subcommand handler with listen (daemon), emit (fire-and-forget), install, uninstall, and opencode sub-subcommands. Wire into main.rs Command enum.

subtasks.description: Create bridge/cmd.rs with BridgeSubcommand enum (Listen, Emit, Install, Uninstall, Opencode) and cmd_bridge async handler. Implement build_emit_event() to construct BridgeEvent from CLI flags (--cli, --event, --session, --card-id, --tool, --stage). Session ID falls back to $SESSION_ID/$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID env vars. Implement run_listener() with Unix socket accept loop, SIGTERM/Ctrl-C handling, JSONL event logging, and stale socket detection.

Wire Bridge subcommand into main.rs: add `mod bridge;` import, Bridge variant to Command enum with #[command(subcommand)] BridgeSubcommand, and route `Command::Bridge { sub } => bridge::cmd_bridge(sub).await`.

verification.command: cargo build -p bop && ./target/debug/bop bridge emit --cli claude --event session-start --session test-123; echo "exit: $?"
verification.expected: Build succeeds, emit exits 0 (noop since no socket running)

phases.name: Claude Code hook installer
phases.description: Install/uninstall bop bridge hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json using merge strategy (read existing -> merge hooks key -> write back, never clobber).

subtasks.description: Create bridge/hook_installer.rs with install_claude_hooks() and uninstall_claude_hooks(). Install reads/creates ~/.claude/settings.json, merges SessionStart/PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop hook entries pointing to `bop bridge emit` commands. Uninstall retains non-bop hooks and cleans empty arrays/objects. Uses marker string 'bop bridge emit' for identification.

verification.expected: 4 tests pass: test_install_into_empty_settings, test_install_merges_existing_settings, test_install_appends_existing_hooks, test_uninstall_removes_bop_hooks_only

phases.name: opencode SSE adapter
phases.description: Async SSE listener that connects to opencode's event bus and translates events to BridgeEvents. Port discovery from $OPENCODE_PORT or default 4096.

subtasks.description: Create bridge/opencode.rs with listen_opencode() async function. Connects to GET http://localhost:{port}/event with SSE Accept header. Parses SSE stream (event:/data: lines). Translates session.status busy->InProgress, idle->HumanReview, retry->AwaitingHuman. Translates message.part.delta->ToolStart, permission.updated->AwaitingHuman. Robust JSON field extraction with multiple path fallbacks.

phases.name: Nushell bridge skill script
phases.description: Create the bop-bridge.nu Nushell script that wraps bop bridge emit for use inside AI sessions.

subtasks.description: Create vibekanban/bop-bridge.nu with 'bridge stage' exported command. Takes stage name and optional card_id. Wraps `bop bridge emit --cli <cli> --event stage-change --stage <stage>`. Follows existing vibekanban/bop-provider.nu style.

verification.expected: File exists with shebang and 'bridge stage' function definition

phases.name: Integration verification
phases.description: Verify all components work together: build, all tests pass, emit+listen roundtrip works, hook install/uninstall works.

subtasks.description: Run full acceptance criteria: (1) cargo build succeeds, (2) all bridge tests pass (14 total), (3) clippy clean, (4) fmt clean, (5) bridge emit exits 0 with no socket, (6) bridge listen creates/removes socket on interrupt. Verify no regressions in existing tests.

verification.command: cargo build -p bop && cargo test -p bop bridge 2>&1 | tail -5 && cargo clippy -p bop -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -1 && cargo fmt --check
verification.expected: Build succeeds, 14 bridge tests pass, clippy clean, fmt clean

parallel_groups.reason: Both depend only on phase-1-core-types, completely disjoint file sets (hook_installer.rs vs opencode.rs)

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Minimal — all phases are in the same crate, single-crate build serializes anyway

summary.implementation_status: All code already exists on main branch. Bridge module (mod.rs, cmd.rs, hook_installer.rs, opencode.rs) fully implemented with 14 passing tests. Nushell skill script in place. Main.rs wired. Build/clippy/fmt all clean.
summary.startup_command: cargo build -p bop && cargo test -p bop bridge

acceptance_criteria: cargo build -p bop succeeds with zero errors
cargo test -p bop bridge passes all 14 tests
cargo clippy -p bop -- -D warnings passes clean
bop bridge emit --cli claude --event session-start --session test-123 exits 0
bop bridge listen creates socket and cleans up on interrupt
verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk feature adding new CLI subcommand with Unix socket IPC and external JSON file manipulation. Unit tests cover serialization, hook install/uninstall, and SSE translation logic.
